result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: a major issue with cut-off content at the bottom of the page, and two minor text truncation issues in the restaurant listings.

issues.description: Bottom restaurant card is incomplete and cut off by the viewport, preventing users from seeing the full restaurant name and complete details
issues.suggestion: Ensure all card content is fully visible within the viewport or implement proper scrolling/pagination so users can see complete restaurant information

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the third 'Fastest near you' card appears truncated, likely should be 'Trattoria Piccolo'
issues.suggestion: Use text truncation with ellipsis (...) or adjust card width to fully display restaurant names

issues.description: Category filter pills on the right side are partially cut off, indicating there are more categories but the scroll affordance is not obvious
issues.suggestion: Add visual indicators (arrows or scroll hints) to show users that more categories are available, or implement horizontal scrolling with better visibility
